about: Mutants of compiler/check/rows, the self-hosted checker's row pass (capstone S3, tip 5b S3-ROWS). The agreement with the Go checker over testdata/rows (TestCompilerRowsAgreeWithChecker) kills each.

mutants.name: rows-tail-not-escaping
mutants.rule: A fallible call left as the body's value, or a branch's that ends it, lets its failure escape (tails.go, k.ret).

mutants.name: rows-literal-skipped
mutants.to: walk(env, w, s, k, syntax.FuncLitOf(k.Parsed[w.file].Tree, x).Body)
mutants.rule: A function literal's body is a target of its own, checked against the rows it writes or its context's function type gives (call.go funcLit), never the enclosing function's.

mutants.name: rows-try-not-counted
mutants.rule: Under try every fallible argument propagates, at the argument (handled, argValue).

mutants.name: rows-return-not-escaping
mutants.from: valueAt(env, w, s, k, r.Value, r.Value)
mutants.rule: return of a fallible call passes its failure on (stmt.go return).

mutants.name: rows-capability-receiver-free
mutants.rule: An operation called on a capability named as the receiver charges that capability (call.go modeCapFn).

mutants.name: rows-uses-membership-ignored
mutants.rule: A capability the written row holds is no S102.

mutants.name: rows-errors-membership-ignored
mutants.rule: Only the failures the written error row does not list are S101 (rows.go escape, minus).

mutants.name: rows-literal-writes-clause
mutants.from:
if st.lit {

mutants.to:

mutants.rule: A literal's site names no clause to write (pend: t.decl is nil): it is reported as the literal's, not the declaration's.

mutants.name: rows-clause-unsorted
mutants.rule: The elements a clause adds are sorted by spelling, whatever their order of declaration (clauseFix).

mutants.name: rows-clause-always-new
mutants.from: let text = if written >= 0 { " | " + joined } else { " " + clause + " " + joined }
mutants.rule: Elements missing from a written clause are added to it, not written as a second clause (clauseFix).

mutants.name: rows-with-block-skipped
mutants.rule: A try in a with's block lets its failure escape the target, as anywhere in the body (rows.md, With 6).

mutants.name: rows-with-charges-read
mutants.rule: Inside a with the context discharges what it binds: this pass does not resolve the binds, so it charges nothing there (D3: no cascade).

mutants.name: rows-test-skipped
mutants.rule: A test's capability row is empty: a capability it charges outside a with is S102, with no clause to write (E4).

mutants.name: rows-decode-row-ignored
mutants.to: if false && dense.In(env.decs, n) && dense.Of(env.decs, n) >= 0 {
mutants.rule: decode[T](r) fails its codec's row (types.md, Codecs 2): a failure there the error row does not list escapes (S101).

mutants.name: harness-port-never-admits
mutants.rule: runtime.md Tests, harnesses 2: a test with no parameters may charge a capability with a harness (the sorted-insert example's draws), as the Go checker admits it.

mutants.name: rows-catch-rest-dropped
mutants.rule: A partial catch's rest, the failures no arm names, escapes through the try, at the try (handlers.go try).

mutants.name: rows-error-value-kept
mutants.rule: A returned or tail value of an error type that is not the result's type escapes as a failure (stmt.go returnedErrorRow).

mutants.name: rows-span-past-comment
mutants.rule: A row report's span stays on its first line and ends before a comment that ends that line (check.go report).

mutants.to:

mutants.rule: RowsWithLimit reports one S108 at the first overflowing function in declaration order.

mutants.name: type-budget-rows-cascades-after
mutants.rule: Once a declaration overflows the type budget, diagnostics from all later declarations are suppressed.

mutants.name: type-budget-rows-body-cascades
mutants.rule: A body that overflows the type budget is left unknown so its own diagnostics are suppressed.

mutants.name: type-budget-rows-ignores-pool-spent
mutants.rule: RowsWithLimit counts store.PoolSpent(s) in the package base budget before per-body meters.
